title: ""
pagetitle: "Zihan Liang - AI Conference Deadlines"
title-prefix: ""
description-meta: "Upcoming AI, machine learning, computer vision, NLP, robotics, and related conference submission deadlines."
page-layout: full
title-block: false
---

```{=html}
<div class="site-shell deadlines-page" aria-label="AI conference deadlines">
  <header class="deadlines-hero">
    <div class="deadlines-hero-copy">
      <h2 class="section-title deadlines-title">AI Conference Deadlines</h2>
      <p class="deadlines-intro">
        Upcoming submission deadlines across machine learning, computer vision,
        natural language processing, robotics, and related fields.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="deadlines-data-meta" aria-live="polite">
      <span id="deadlines-data-state" class="deadlines-data-state is-loading">
        <span class="deadlines-data-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        Loading deadline data
      </span>
      <span id="deadlines-data-updated" class="deadlines-data-updated"></span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="deadlines-controls" aria-label="Filter conference deadlines">
    <div class="deadlines-field deadlines-search-field">
      <label for="deadlines-search">Search</label>
      <input
        id="deadlines-search"
        type="search"
        inputmode="search"
        autocomplete="off"
        placeholder="Conference or location"
      />
    </div>

    <div class="deadlines-field">
      <label for="deadlines-subject">Research area</label>
      <select id="deadlines-subject">
        <option value="">All areas</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <label class="deadlines-predicted-toggle" for="deadlines-include-predicted">
      <input id="deadlines-include-predicted" type="checkbox" checked />
      <span>Include predicted dates</span>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="deadlines-results-head">
    <p id="deadlines-results-summary" class="deadlines-results-summary">Preparing deadlines…</p>
    <p class="deadlines-timezone">Times shown in <span id="deadlines-local-timezone">your local timezone</span></p>
  </div>

  <div id="deadlines-loading" class="deadlines-loading" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="deadlines-loading-row"></div>
    <div class="deadlines-loading-row"></div>
    <div class="deadlines-loading-row"></div>
  </div>

  <div id="deadlines-list" class="deadlines-list" role="list"></div>

  <div id="deadlines-empty" class="deadlines-empty" hidden>
    <h2>No matching deadlines</h2>
    <p>Try another conference name, location, or research area.</p>
  </div>

  <div id="deadlines-error" class="deadlines-empty deadlines-error" hidden>
    <h2>Deadline data is temporarily unavailable</h2>
    <p>Please try again later or visit the source listing directly.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="deadlines-more-wrap">
    <button id="deadlines-load-more" class="deadlines-load-more" type="button" hidden>
      Show more deadlines
    </button>
  </div>

  <footer class="deadlines-source-note">
    <p>
      Conference data from
      <a href="https://github.com/mlciv/ai-deadlines" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AI Conference Deadlines</a>.
      Predicted dates are labeled; always verify a deadline on the official conference website.
    </p>
  </footer>
</div>

<script src="assets/js/deadlines.js"></script>
```
